info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Recordings Retrieval API facilitates access to a repository of meeting recordings, allowing users to view and retrieve specific recordings associated with their meetings. This API serves as a vital resource for businesses that conduct virtual meetings and require a systematic way to manage and access recorded content. Typical consumers include meeting coordinators, project managers, and team members seeking to reference past discussions or decisions. Utilize this endpoint to streamline retrieval processes and enhance collaboration among team members by providing easy access to valuable recorded meetings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the recorded sessions of meetings for review and reference purposes. It provides access to audio, video, and any associated data from the meetings.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving recording details of a meeting. This includes the necessary parameters to specify which recording to fetch.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested recording data.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON body for the GET request to retrieve meeting recordings.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsResponse_2.description: Response schema for retrieving meeting recording information.

createdBy.description: The user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A higher value indicates longer processing time.
